newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks seen opening higher.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks seen opening higher.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to move higher at the start of trading Friday as bonds got a boost from comments made Thursday by Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan.
Greenspan said he expected U.S. economic growth to decelerate later this year and into next, comments interpreted by some to mean that he will not raise rates at then next FOMC meeting on May 20.
But even if he were to raise rates, a further tightening by 25 basis points has been discounted by the market.
